form.label: VMware vSphere / ESXi / vCenter - SOC Overview
form.description: Ingestion health, authentication, vCenter tasks, vmkernel errors, and NSX DFW firewall activity for vmware:esxlog:*, vmware:vclog:*, and vmware:nsxlog:* sourcetypes. Not field-validated: panels are conservative and based on synthetic-equivalent fixture evidence only. Verify field availability before relying on panel counts.

search.query: (index=infraops OR index=netfw) host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search vendor=vmware product=vsphere | stats count
index=netfw sourcetype="vmware:nsxlog:dfwpktlogs" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search (action=blocked OR vmware_nsx_raw_action IN (DROP, REJECT)) | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype="vmware:esxlog:vmkernel" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search (severity=warning OR severity=error) | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype IN (vmware:esxlog:hostd, vmware:vclog:vpxd) host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search (op=Login OR action=Login) | stats count
(index=infraops OR index=netfw) host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search vendor=vmware product=vsphere | timechart count by sourcetype

index=infraops sourcetype IN (vmware:esxlog:hostd, vmware:vclog:vpxd) host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search (op=Login OR action=Login) | eval login_result=coalesce(result, "unknown") | stats count by host, src_user, dest, login_result, _time | sort -_time | head 100
index=infraops sourcetype="vmware:vclog:vpxd" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search op=TaskEvent result=completed | stats count by host, src_user, dest, signature | sort -count | head 50
index=infraops sourcetype="vmware:esxlog:vmkernel" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search severity=warning | stats count by host, signature | sort -count | head 50

panel.title: NSX DFW allowed traffic (top src/dst pairs)

search.query: index=netfw sourcetype="vmware:nsxlog:dfwpktlogs" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search (action=allowed OR vmware_nsx_raw_action=PASS) | stats count by src_ip, dest_ip, dest_port, transport, rule | sort -count | head 50

panel.title: NSX DFW blocked traffic (top src/dst pairs)

search.query: index=netfw sourcetype="vmware:nsxlog:dfwpktlogs" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search (action=blocked OR vmware_nsx_raw_action IN (DROP, REJECT)) | stats count by src_ip, dest_ip, dest_port, transport, rule, vmware_nsx_raw_action | sort -count | head 50

index=infraops sourcetype="vmware:esxlog:sdata" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | eval evt_severity=coalesce(severity, "unknown") | stats count by host, signature_id, evt_severity | sort -count | head 50

panel.title: SPL for manual triage (copy and run)
panel.html:
NSX DFW drilldown:
index=netfw sourcetype="vmware:nsxlog:dfwpktlogs" | table _time host src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport rule vmware_nsx_raw_action direction _raw

Auth events:
index=infraops sourcetype IN (vmware:esxlog:hostd, vmware:vclog:vpxd) (op=Login OR action=Login) | table _time host sourcetype src_user dest op result _raw

All VMware events:
(index=infraops OR index=netfw) vendor=vmware product=vsphere | table _time index sourcetype host action signature severity _raw

Note: panels use synthetic-equivalent fixture evidence; not field-validated on live VMware sources.
